fact: The Minister of Justice's written reply of 1 September 2025 says 19 courts have adopted the Court Online system, an online document management system, the first two (Pretoria and Johannesburg High Courts) going live on 30 September 2022 and the 19th around August 2025, with Mahikeng and Free State High Courts scheduled for October 2025.
Deputy Minister Andries Nel said Court Online, an integrated end-to-end digital case management solution, went live at the Eastern Cape Division of the High Court in Gqeberha on 16 July 2025.
Nel said Court Online, now live for the Eastern Cape High Court, is powered by Microsoft for e-filing and case management.
The KwaZulu-Natal Division's Directive 1 of 2026 governs case numbers allocated and documents uploaded to virtual court files on Court Online and CaseLines.
The directive requires process to be uploaded for issuing on Court Online and supporting documents uploaded once the case number is allocated, by legal practitioners and litigants.
